mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, balance, frozen_balance as frozenBalance, total_recharge as totalRecharge, total_consume as totalConsume, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from wallets where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wallets (user_id, balance, frozen_balance, total_recharge, total_consume) values (#{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id)
